et_opts.title: Ethiopia filter choices
et_opts.description: Regions, zones, genders, respondent roles and typology classes in the Ethiopia household data. Reads et_interview_meta.
et_opts.sql:
SELECT 'region' AS field, admin1_state_region AS value FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta` WHERE admin1_state_region IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'zone', zone_name FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta` WHERE zone_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'gender', respondent_gender FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta` WHERE respondent_gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'role', respondent_role FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta` WHERE respondent_role IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'typology', typology FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta` WHERE typology IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 2
ORDER BY field, value

et_tr_hybrid.title: Ethiopia hybrid concept signals
et_tr_hybrid.description: Among households interested in hybrid wheat: share naming each attribute of interest, first choice and priority index. Reads et_traits and et_interview_meta.
et_tr_hybrid.sql:
WITH hh AS (
  SELECT hhid, ANY_VALUE(respondent_gender) AS respondent_gender, ANY_VALUE(admin1_state_region) AS region, ANY_VALUE(zone_name) AS zone
  FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta`
  WHERE hhid IS NOT NULL AND (CAST({{et_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin1_state_region = CAST({{et_region}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{et_zone}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR zone_name = CAST({{et_zone}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{et_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{et_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{et_role}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_role = CAST({{et_role}} AS STRING))
  GROUP BY hhid
),
tr AS (SELECT * FROM `{DS}.et_traits` WHERE hhid IN (SELECT hhid FROM hh)),
v AS (SELECT * FROM tr WHERE domain = 'Hybrid concept attributes'),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) AS respondents FROM v)
SELECT trait_short, ANY_VALUE(n.respondents) AS hybrid_respondents,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(selected, response_id, NULL)), ANY_VALUE(n.respondents)) AS interest_share,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_first, response_id, NULL)), ANY_VALUE(n.respondents)) AS first_choice_share,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(rank_points), 3 * ANY_VALUE(n.respondents)) AS priority_index
FROM v, n
GROUP BY trait_short
ORDER BY priority_index DESC, trait_short

et_tr_kpi.title: Ethiopia trait headline figures
et_tr_kpi.description: Households ranking variety traits, traits named important per household, the leading trait by priority index and the top three's share of rank points. Reads et_traits and et_interview_meta.
et_tr_kpi.sql:
WITH hh AS (
  SELECT hhid, ANY_VALUE(respondent_gender) AS respondent_gender, ANY_VALUE(admin1_state_region) AS region, ANY_VALUE(zone_name) AS zone
  FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta`
  WHERE hhid IS NOT NULL AND (CAST({{et_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin1_state_region = CAST({{et_region}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{et_zone}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR zone_name = CAST({{et_zone}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{et_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{et_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{et_role}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_role = CAST({{et_role}} AS STRING))
  GROUP BY hhid
),
tr AS (SELECT * FROM `{DS}.et_traits` WHERE hhid IN (SELECT hhid FROM hh)),
v AS (SELECT * FROM tr WHERE domain = 'Variety priorities'),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) AS respondents, COUNTIF(selected) AS selected_rows, SUM(rank_points) AS points FROM v),
t AS (SELECT trait_short, SUM(rank_points) AS points FROM v GROUP BY trait_short),
lead AS (SELECT trait_short, SAFE_DIVIDE(points, 3 * (SELECT respondents FROM n)) AS idx FROM t ORDER BY idx DESC, trait_short LIMIT 1),
top3 AS (SELECT SUM(points) AS p FROM (SELECT points FROM t ORDER BY points DESC, trait_short LIMIT 3))
SELECT n.respondents AS trait_respondents,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(n.selected_rows, n.respondents) AS avg_important_traits,
  (SELECT trait_short FROM lead) AS leading_trait,
  (SELECT idx FROM lead) AS leader_priority_index,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT p FROM top3), n.points) AS top3_concentration
FROM n

et_tr_saved.sql:

  FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta`

et_wtp_gender.title: Ethiopia premium and yield by gender
et_wtp_gender.description: Per respondent gender: complete trade-offs, median premium, median extra ETB per quintal and median required yield gain. Reads et_wtp and et_interview_meta.
et_wtp_gender.sql:
WITH hh AS (
  SELECT hhid, ANY_VALUE(respondent_gender) AS respondent_gender, ANY_VALUE(admin1_state_region) AS region, ANY_VALUE(zone_name) AS zone
  FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta`
  WHERE hhid IS NOT NULL AND (CAST({{ew_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin1_state_region = CAST({{ew_region}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_zone}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR zone_name = CAST({{ew_zone}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{ew_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{ew_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_role}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_role = CAST({{ew_role}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_typology}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR typology = CAST({{ew_typology}} AS STRING))
  GROUP BY hhid
),
w AS (SELECT w.*, hh.respondent_gender, hh.region, hh.zone FROM `{DS}.et_wtp` w JOIN hh USING (hhid)),
wv AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE wtp_response_valid),
yv AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE yield_response_valid),
x AS (
  SELECT IFNULL(w.respondent_gender, 'Not recorded') AS gender_label, w.*,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(IF(wtp_response_valid, wtp_premium, NULL), 0.5) OVER g AS med_premium,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(IF(wtp_response_valid, maximum_extra_wtp_birr_per_qt, NULL), 0.5) OVER g AS med_extra,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(IF(yield_response_valid, yield_gain_needed, NULL), 0.5) OVER g AS med_yield
  FROM w WINDOW g AS (PARTITION BY IFNULL(w.respondent_gender, 'Not recorded'))
)
SELECT gender_label AS gender, COUNTIF(tradeoff_response_valid) AS complete_tradeoffs,
  ANY_VALUE(med_premium) AS median_premium, ANY_VALUE(med_extra) AS median_extra_wtp, ANY_VALUE(med_yield) AS median_yield_gain
FROM x GROUP BY gender_label ORDER BY gender_label

et_wtp_kpi.title: Ethiopia WTP headline figures
et_wtp_kpi.description: Complete price-and-yield trade-offs, median current seed price, extra amount farmers would pay, implied price ceiling, premium and required yield gain. Reads et_wtp and et_interview_meta.
et_wtp_kpi.sql:
WITH hh AS (
  SELECT hhid, ANY_VALUE(respondent_gender) AS respondent_gender, ANY_VALUE(admin1_state_region) AS region, ANY_VALUE(zone_name) AS zone
  FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta`
  WHERE hhid IS NOT NULL AND (CAST({{ew_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin1_state_region = CAST({{ew_region}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_zone}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR zone_name = CAST({{ew_zone}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{ew_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{ew_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_role}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_role = CAST({{ew_role}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_typology}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR typology = CAST({{ew_typology}} AS STRING))
  GROUP BY hhid
),
w AS (SELECT w.*, hh.respondent_gender, hh.region, hh.zone FROM `{DS}.et_wtp` w JOIN hh USING (hhid)),
wv AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE wtp_response_valid),
yv AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE yield_response_valid)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNTIF(tradeoff_response_valid) FROM w) AS complete_tradeoffs,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w) AS eligible,
  FORMAT("%'d / %'d", (SELECT COUNTIF(tradeoff_response_valid) FROM w), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM w)) AS complete_eligible,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(current_seed_price_birr_per_qt, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM wv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_current_price,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(maximum_extra_wtp_birr_per_qt, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM wv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_extra_wtp,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(implied_hybrid_price_birr_per_qt, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM wv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_implied_price,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(wtp_premium, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM wv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_premium,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(yield_gain_needed, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM yv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_yield_gain,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(wtp_premium, 0.25) OVER () AS m FROM wv WHERE TRUE)) AS premium_p25,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(wtp_premium, 0.75) OVER () AS m FROM wv WHERE TRUE)) AS premium_p75

et_wtp_reach.title: Ethiopia farmers at each premium
et_wtp_reach.description: Share of farmers with a valid price answer who would pay at least each premium over today's seed price. Reads et_wtp and et_interview_meta.
et_wtp_reach.sql:
WITH hh AS (
  SELECT hhid, ANY_VALUE(respondent_gender) AS respondent_gender, ANY_VALUE(admin1_state_region) AS region, ANY_VALUE(zone_name) AS zone
  FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta`
  WHERE hhid IS NOT NULL AND (CAST({{ew_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin1_state_region = CAST({{ew_region}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_zone}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR zone_name = CAST({{ew_zone}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{ew_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{ew_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_role}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_role = CAST({{ew_role}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_typology}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR typology = CAST({{ew_typology}} AS STRING))
  GROUP BY hhid
),
w AS (SELECT w.*, hh.respondent_gender, hh.region, hh.zone FROM `{DS}.et_wtp` w JOIN hh USING (hhid)),
wv AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE wtp_response_valid),
yv AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE yield_response_valid)
SELECT t AS premium_threshold, COUNTIF(wv.wtp_premium >= t) AS farmers,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(wv.wtp_premium >= t), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wv)) AS reach_share
FROM UNNEST([0.0, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00]) AS t LEFT JOIN wv ON TRUE
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

et_wtp_region.title: Ethiopia thresholds by region and zone
et_wtp_region.description: Per region and zone: valid price answers, median extra ETB per quintal, median premium, share at 25% or more, median yield gain and sample note. Reads et_wtp and et_interview_meta.
et_wtp_region.sql:
WITH hh AS (
  SELECT hhid, ANY_VALUE(respondent_gender) AS respondent_gender, ANY_VALUE(admin1_state_region) AS region, ANY_VALUE(zone_name) AS zone
  FROM `{DS}.et_interview_meta`
  WHERE hhid IS NOT NULL AND (CAST({{ew_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin1_state_region = CAST({{ew_region}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_zone}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR zone_name = CAST({{ew_zone}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{ew_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{ew_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_role}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_role = CAST({{ew_role}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{ew_typology}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR typology = CAST({{ew_typology}} AS STRING))
  GROUP BY hhid
),

wv AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE wtp_response_valid),
yv AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE yield_response_valid),
x AS (
  SELECT IFNULL(w.region, 'Not recorded') AS region_label, IFNULL(w.zone, 'Not recorded') AS zone_label, w.*,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(IF(wtp_response_valid, wtp_premium, NULL), 0.5) OVER p AS med_premium,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(IF(wtp_response_valid, maximum_extra_wtp_birr_per_qt, NULL), 0.5) OVER p AS med_extra,

  COUNTIF(wtp_response_valid) AS valid_price_n,
  ANY_VALUE(med_extra) AS median_extra_wtp,
  ANY_VALUE(med_premium) AS median_premium,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNTIF(wtp_response_valid AND wtp_premium >= 0.25), COUNTIF(wtp_response_valid)) AS share_25_plus,
  ANY_VALUE(med_yield) AS median_yield_gain,
  IF(COUNTIF(tradeoff_response_valid) < 10, FORMAT("Directional (n=%'d)", COUNTIF(tradeoff_response_valid)), FORMAT("n=%'d", COUNTIF(tradeoff_response_valid))) AS sample_note
FROM x GROUP BY region_label, zone_label
ORDER BY region_label, zone_label

la_opts.title: LATAM filter choices
la_opts.description: Countries, departments, genders, respondent roles, concepts and currencies in the LATAM maize data. Reads latam_respondents and latam_concepts.
la_opts.sql:
SELECT 'country' AS field, country AS value, 0 AS ord FROM `{DS}.latam_respondents` GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'dept', department, 0 FROM `{DS}.latam_respondents` GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'gender', respondent_gender, 0 FROM `{DS}.latam_respondents` GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'segment', respondent_segment, 0 FROM `{DS}.latam_respondents` GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'concept', concept, CAST(MIN(concept_code) AS INT64) FROM `{DS}.latam_concepts` GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'pref', concept_preferred, 0 FROM `{DS}.latam_respondents` GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL SELECT 'currency', wtp_currency, 0 FROM `{DS}.latam_respondents` GROUP BY 2
ORDER BY field, ord, value

la_tr_heat.title: LATAM attractive traits by concept
la_tr_heat.description: Per concept and trait: share of exposures to the concept in which the respondent named the trait attractive. Reads latam_concept_traits and latam_respondents.
la_tr_heat.sql:
WITH lr AS (
  SELECT * FROM `{DS}.latam_respondents`
  WHERE (CAST({{la_country}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR country = CAST({{la_country}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{la_dept}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR department = CAST({{la_dept}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{la_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{la_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{la_segment}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_segment = CAST({{la_segment}} AS STRING))
),
lc AS (SELECT c.* FROM `{DS}.latam_concepts` c JOIN lr USING (response_id) WHERE (CAST({{la_concept}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR c.concept = CAST({{la_concept}} AS STRING))),
lt AS (SELECT t.* FROM `{DS}.latam_concept_traits` t JOIN lr USING (response_id) WHERE (CAST({{la_concept}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR t.concept = CAST({{la_concept}} AS STRING))),
by_concept AS (
  SELECT concept, COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) AS respondents,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_preferred, response_id, NULL)), COUNT(DISTINCT response_id)) AS preferred_share,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_least_preferred, response_id, NULL)), COUNT(DISTINCT response_id)) AS least_share
  FROM lc GROUP BY concept
),
e AS (SELECT concept, COUNT(DISTINCT exposure_id) AS exposures FROM lt GROUP BY concept)
SELECT lt.concept || ' · ' || lt.trait AS row_key, lt.concept, MIN(lt.concept_code) AS concept_code, lt.trait,
  ANY_VALUE(lt.trait_group) AS trait_group, CAST(MIN(lt.trait_code) AS INT64) AS trait_order,
  ANY_VALUE(e.exposures) AS exposures,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(lt.selected, lt.exposure_id, NULL)), ANY_VALUE(e.exposures)) AS attractive_share
FROM lt JOIN e USING (concept)
GROUP BY lt.concept, lt.trait
ORDER BY concept_code, trait_order

la_tr_kpi.title: LATAM concept headline figures
la_tr_kpi.description: Respondents exposed to concepts, full exposures, the most preferred concept and its share, interest in trying, and attractive traits named per exposure. Reads latam_concepts, latam_concept_traits and latam_respondents.
la_tr_kpi.sql:

  WHERE (CAST({{la_country}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR country = CAST({{la_country}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{la_dept}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR department = CAST({{la_dept}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{la_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{la_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{la_segment}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_segment = CAST({{la_segment}} AS STRING))
),
lc AS (SELECT c.* FROM `{DS}.latam_concepts` c JOIN lr USING (response_id) WHERE (CAST({{la_concept}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR c.concept = CAST({{la_concept}} AS STRING))),
lt AS (SELECT t.* FROM `{DS}.latam_concept_traits` t JOIN lr USING (response_id) WHERE (CAST({{la_concept}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR t.concept = CAST({{la_concept}} AS STRING))),
by_concept AS (
  SELECT concept, COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) AS respondents,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_preferred, response_id, NULL)), COUNT(DISTINCT response_id)) AS preferred_share,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_least_preferred, response_id, NULL)), COUNT(DISTINCT response_id)) AS least_share
  FROM lc GROUP BY concept
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM lc) AS concept_respondents,
  (SELECT COUNTIF(shown_in_full) FROM lc) AS exposures,
  IFNULL((SELECT concept FROM by_concept ORDER BY preferred_share DESC, concept LIMIT 1), 'No data') AS leading_concept,
  (SELECT MAX(preferred_share) FROM by_concept) AS leading_preferred_share,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(interested_trial, response_id, NULL)) FROM lc),
              (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(trial_interest_score IS NOT NULL, response_id, NULL)) FROM lc)) AS interested_trying,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNTIF(selected) FROM lt), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT exposure_id) FROM lt)) AS avg_attractive_traits

la_tr_pref.description: Per concept: respondents who saw it, and the shares who chose it as most and as least preferred. Reads latam_concepts and latam_respondents.

lw_kpi.title: LATAM WTP headline figures
lw_kpi.description: Valid premiums, median premium for the preferred concept, share at 25% or more, share who would pay more, and median maximum and current prices per currency. Reads latam_respondents.
lw_kpi.sql:
WITH lr AS (
  SELECT * FROM `{DS}.latam_respondents`
  WHERE (CAST({{lw_country}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR country = CAST({{lw_country}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{lw_dept}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR department = CAST({{lw_dept}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{lw_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{lw_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{lw_segment}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_segment = CAST({{lw_segment}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{lw_pref}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR concept_preferred = CAST({{lw_pref}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{lw_currency}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR wtp_currency = CAST({{lw_currency}} AS STRING))
),
lv AS (SELECT * FROM lr WHERE premium_valid),
cur AS (
  SELECT wtp_currency,
    ANY_VALUE(mx) AS med_max, ANY_VALUE(mc) AS med_cur
  FROM (
    SELECT wtp_currency,
      PERCENTILE_CONT(wtp_max_price, 0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY wtp_currency) AS mx,
      PERCENTILE_CONT(IF(premium_valid, price_current, NULL), 0.5) OVER (PARTITION BY wtp_currency) AS mc
    FROM lr WHERE wtp_currency <> 'Not recorded'
  ) GROUP BY wtp_currency
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM lv) AS valid_premiums,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM lr) AS respondents,
  FORMAT("%'d / %'d", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM lv), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM lr)) AS valid_respondents,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(premium, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM lv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_premium,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(premium >= 0.25, response_id, NULL)) FROM lv), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM lv)) AS share_25_plus,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(wtp_comparison = 'More for this product', response_id, NULL)) FROM lr),
              (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(wtp_comparison <> 'Not recorded', response_id, NULL)) FROM lr)) AS would_pay_more,
  IFNULL((SELECT STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%s %s', REGEXP_REPLACE(FORMAT("%'.1f", med_max), r'\.0$', ''), wtp_currency), '  |  ' ORDER BY wtp_currency) FROM cur WHERE med_max IS NOT NULL), 'No prices') AS median_max_price,
  IFNULL((SELECT STRING_AGG(FORMAT('%s %s', REGEXP_REPLACE(FORMAT("%'.1f", med_cur), r'\.0$', ''), wtp_currency), '  |  ' ORDER BY wtp_currency) FROM cur WHERE med_cur IS NOT NULL), 'No prices') AS median_current_price,
  'Premium = (maximum price for the preferred concept - current seed price) / current price, same currency and reference unit (kg, lb or bag). '
    || FORMAT("%'d valid premiums from %'d respondents. ", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM lv), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM lr))
    || 'Price cards list one median per currency (GTQ, HNL, USD) per purchase unit, not per kg; currencies are never converted or pooled.' AS context

),
cov AS (
  SELECT * FROM `{DS}.survey_coverage`
  WHERE (CAST({{p_crop}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR crop = CAST({{p_crop}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{p_stakeholder}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR stakeholder = CAST({{p_stakeholder}} AS STRING))
),
resp AS (
  SELECT r.* FROM `{DS}.survey_responses` r JOIN forms f USING (survey_form_id)
  WHERE (CAST({{p_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR r.respondent_gender = CAST({{p_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{p_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR r.admin1 = CAST({{p_region}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{p_start}} AS DATE) IS NULL OR r.monitoring_date >= CAST({{p_start}} AS DATE))
    AND (CAST({{p_end}} AS DATE) IS NULL OR r.monitoring_date <= CAST({{p_end}} AS DATE))
    AND r.portfolio_id IN (SELECT portfolio_id FROM cov)
),
cov_r AS (SELECT c.* FROM cov c JOIN resp r USING (portfolio_id)),
src AS (SELECT s.* FROM `{DS}.source_status` s JOIN forms f USING (survey_form_id)),
live AS (  -- forms whose numbers show: monitored and connected (DAX returns BLANK otherwise)
  SELECT f.survey_form_id FROM forms f JOIN src s USING (survey_form_id)
  WHERE f.monitoring_enabled AND s.connection_valid
),
ru AS (SELECT * FROM resp WHERE survey_form_id IN (SELECT survey_form_id FROM live)),
k AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNTIF(connection_valid) FROM src) AS connected,
    (SELECT COUNTIF(monitoring_enabled) FROM forms) AS monitored,
    (SELECT SUM(rows_not_loaded) FROM src) AS rows_not_loaded,
    (SELECT SUM(server_submissions) FROM src) AS server_submissions,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT portfolio_id) FROM resp WHERE usable_response) AS completed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ru) AS submissions,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT portfolio_id) FROM ru WHERE usable_response) AS usable,
    (SELECT COUNTIF(completion_status = 'Pilot / training / test') FROM resp) AS pilots,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.study_id) FROM resp r JOIN forms f USING (survey_form_id) WHERE r.usable_response) AS studies,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.country) FROM resp r JOIN forms f USING (survey_form_id) WHERE r.usable_response) AS countries,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.crop) FROM cov_r c JOIN resp r USING (portfolio_id) WHERE r.usable_response AND c.crop <> 'Crop not recorded') AS crops,
    (SELECT MAX(submission_at) FROM resp) AS last_at,
    (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(duration_min, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM resp WHERE duration_min > 0)) AS median_duration,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT portfolio_id) FROM ru WHERE usable_response AND respondent_gender = 'Female') AS female,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT portfolio_id) FROM ru WHERE usable_response AND respondent_gender IN ('Female', 'Male')) AS gender_known,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT portfolio_id) FROM ru WHERE usable_response AND respondent_age IS NOT NULL) AS age_known,
    (SELECT AVG(respondent_age) FROM resp WHERE usable_response) AS avg_age,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT admin1) FROM resp WHERE usable_response AND admin1 <> 'Not recorded') AS regions,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.portfolio_id) FROM ru r JOIN forms f USING (survey_form_id) WHERE r.usable_response AND f.survey_form_type = 'Listing') AS listing,
    (SELECT COUNTIF(f.survey_form_type = 'Listing' AND s.connection_valid) FROM forms f JOIN src s USING (survey_form_id)) AS listing_sources
)
SELECT
  IF(connected = 0, NULL, completed) AS completed_interviews,
  IF(connected = 0, NULL, studies) AS studies_with_interviews,
  IF(connected = 0, NULL, countries) AS countries_reached,
  IF(connected = 0, NULL, crops) AS crops_represented,
  IF(connected = 0, 'Source unavailable', IF(last_at IS NULL, 'No submissions yet', FORMAT_DATETIME('%d %b %Y %H:%M', last_at) || ' EAT')) AS latest_submission,
  IF(monitored = 0 OR connected = 0, NULL, submissions) AS submissions_loaded,
  IF(monitored = 0 OR connected = 0, NULL, usable) AS usable_records,
  server_submissions,
  median_duration AS median_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(female, gender_known) AS female_share_known,
  avg_age AS average_age,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(age_known, usable) AS age_coverage,
  regions AS regions_reached,
  IF(listing_sources = 0, NULL, listing) AS listing_records,
  CASE
    WHEN monitored = 0 THEN 'Selected survey is not connected yet'
    WHEN connected = 0 THEN 'Data unavailable - check SurveyCTO connection'
    WHEN connected < monitored THEN FORMAT('Partial coverage - %d of %d monitored sources connected', connected, monitored)
    WHEN IFNULL(rows_not_loaded, 0) > 0 THEN FORMAT('Partial load - %d server records not loaded', rows_not_loaded)
    WHEN completed = 0 THEN 'Connected - no matching completed interviews'
    ELSE 'All monitored sources connected'
  END || IF(pilots > 0, FORMAT('. %d LATAM pilot/training submissions are loaded but excluded from completed interviews and target progress.', pilots), '') AS connection_note
FROM k

WITH mm AS (
  SELECT * FROM `{DS}.tz_market_main`
  WHERE usable_response AND (CAST({{tz_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin1 = CAST({{tz_region}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{tz_district}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin2 = CAST({{tz_district}} AS STRING))

tw AS (SELECT w.* FROM `{DS}.tz_wtp` w JOIN mm USING (response_id)),
n AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) AS respondents FROM tr),
by_trait AS (
  SELECT trait, SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(selected, response_id, NULL)), ANY_VALUE(n.respondents)) AS top3_share,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_first, response_id, NULL)), ANY_VALUE(n.respondents)) AS first_share
  FROM tr, n GROUP BY trait
)
SELECT n.respondents AS trait_respondents,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(three_distinct_ranks, response_id, NULL)) FROM tr), n.respondents) AS three_rank_share,
  (SELECT trait FROM by_trait ORDER BY top3_share DESC, trait LIMIT 1) AS leading_trait,
  (SELECT MAX(top3_share) FROM by_trait) AS leading_top3_share,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNTIF(valid_premium) FROM tw), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM tw)) AS wtp_coverage,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(wtp_premium, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM tw WHERE wtp_premium IS NOT NULL)) AS median_premium
FROM n

n AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) AS respondents FROM tr),
by_trait AS (
  SELECT trait, SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(selected, response_id, NULL)), ANY_VALUE(n.respondents)) AS top3_share,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(is_first, response_id, NULL)), ANY_VALUE(n.respondents)) AS first_share
  FROM tr, n GROUP BY trait
),
c AS (SELECT crop, COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) AS actors FROM tr GROUP BY crop)
SELECT tr.crop || ' · ' || tr.trait AS row_key, tr.crop, tr.trait, ANY_VALUE(c.actors) AS actors,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(tr.selected, tr.response_id, NULL)), ANY_VALUE(c.actors)) AS top3_share,
  IF(ANY_VALUE(c.actors) < 10, FORMAT("Directional (n=%'d)", ANY_VALUE(c.actors)), FORMAT("n=%'d", ANY_VALUE(c.actors))) AS evidence
FROM tr JOIN c USING (crop)
GROUP BY tr.crop, tr.trait
HAVING top3_share > 0
ORDER BY crop, top3_share DESC

tz_wtp_kpi.title: Tanzania paired-price headline figures
tz_wtp_kpi.description: For the chosen product: complete price pairs, median premium or discount against its baseline, share at 25% or more, and median baseline, product and difference in TZS/kg. Reads tz_wtp_products and tz_market_main.
tz_wtp_kpi.sql:
WITH mm AS (
  SELECT * FROM `{DS}.tz_market_main`
  WHERE usable_response AND (CAST({{tw_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin1 = CAST({{tw_region}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{tw_district}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin2 = CAST({{tw_district}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{tw_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{tw_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{tw_segment}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_segment = CAST({{tw_segment}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{tw_crop}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR crop_profile = CAST({{tw_crop}} AS STRING))
),
pp AS (
  SELECT p.*, mm.respondent_segment FROM `{DS}.tz_wtp_products` p JOIN mm USING (response_id)
  WHERE p.product = CAST({{tw_product}} AS STRING)
),
pv AS (SELECT * FROM pp WHERE valid_pair)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM pv) AS paired_respondents,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM pp) AS eligible_actors,
  FORMAT("%'d / %'d", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM pv), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM pp)) AS pairs_actors,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(paired_premium, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM pv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_premium,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT IF(paired_premium >= 0.25, response_id, NULL)) FROM pv), (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) FROM pv)) AS share_25_plus,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(baseline_price_tzs_kg, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM pv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_baseline,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(extra_wtp_tzs_kg, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM pv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_difference,
  (SELECT ANY_VALUE(m) FROM (SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(product_price_tzs_kg, 0.5) OVER () AS m FROM pv WHERE TRUE)) AS median_product_price,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST({{tw_product}} AS STRING) IS NULL THEN 'Select one product to compare its business buying price with the matching baseline. Different products are not pooled.'
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pp) = 0 THEN 'No matching actors for this product and the current filters. Clear filters or select another product.'
    WHEN NOT (SELECT LOGICAL_AND(mapping_ready) FROM pp) THEN 'Groundnut comparison pending: the supplied V23 form has no paired baseline and aflatoxin-free price variables.'
    ELSE 'Baseline: ' || (SELECT ANY_VALUE(baseline) FROM pp) || ' (' || (SELECT ANY_VALUE(baseline_variable) FROM pp) || '). Premium = (product price - baseline price) / baseline price. Both prices are TZS/kg.'
  END AS context

tz_wtp_table.title: Tanzania paired premiums by segment
tz_wtp_table.description: Per crop and actor type for the chosen product: complete pairs, median, 25th and 75th percentile premium, share at 25% or more, and a sample note. Reads tz_wtp_products and tz_market_main.
tz_wtp_table.sql:
WITH mm AS (
  SELECT * FROM `{DS}.tz_market_main`
  WHERE usable_response AND (CAST({{tw_region}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin1 = CAST({{tw_region}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{tw_district}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR admin2 = CAST({{tw_district}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{tw_gender}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_gender = CAST({{tw_gender}} AS STRING)) AND (CAST({{tw_segment}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR respondent_segment = CAST({{tw_segment}} AS STRING))
    AND (CAST({{tw_crop}} AS STRING) IS NULL OR crop_profile = CAST({{tw_crop}} AS STRING))
),
pp AS (
  SELECT p.*, mm.respondent_segment FROM `{DS}.tz_wtp_products` p JOIN mm USING (response_id)
  WHERE p.product = CAST({{tw_product}} AS STRING)
),
pv AS (SELECT * FROM pp WHERE valid_pair),
x AS (
  SELECT pv.*,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(paired_premium, 0.5) OVER g AS med, PERCENTILE_CONT(paired_premium, 0.25) OVER g AS p25,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(paired_premium, 0.75) OVER g AS p75
  FROM pv WINDOW g AS (PARTITION BY crop, respondent_segment)
)
SELECT crop || ' · ' || respondent_segment AS row_key, crop, respondent_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) AS pairs, ANY_VALUE(med) AS median_premium, ANY_VALUE(p25) AS p25, ANY_VALUE(p75) AS p75,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT IF(paired_premium >= 0.25, response_id, NULL)), COUNT(DISTINCT response_id)) AS share_25_plus,
  IF(COUNT(DISTINCT response_id) < 10, 'Preliminary; n=' || COUNT(DISTINCT response_id), FORMAT("n=%'d", COUNT(DISTINCT response_id))) AS evidence
FROM x GROUP BY crop, respondent_segment ORDER BY crop, respondent_segment
